name: NiaHealth
description: Connect your NiaHealth account to ask questions about your health using your lab results, health scores, wearable data, and care team recommendations.

_published_faq.name: How do I add NiaHealth to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add NiaHealth to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.niahealth.co/api/u/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the NiaHealth MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: NiaHealth lists 14 MCP tools, including get_activity_summary, get_adherence_history, get_care_letters, get_clinical_analysis, get_connected_devices, get_data_overview, get_health_scores, get_profile, get_readings, get_recommendations, get_training_zones, and get_wearable_activities.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to NiaHealth?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to NiaHealth in consumer-health on the Manufact MCP catalog include Sweat & Tonic, Vitals Vault, It's Complicated — Therapist Directory, courtsapp, and CheckCells.
NiaHealth requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
NiaHealth is developed by NiaHealth. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
